title: JUDGE
summary: leave so many fond memories, laughter and warm moments between the highlands.

content.text: The four-day Dalai journey of the past three nights has been completely closed,
leave so many fond memories, laughter and warm moments between the highlands.
Today Tourist sends his sincere thanks to the Ladies, especially the eight families who have trusted our choice and joined us on this trip.
Your trust is not only an honor, but also an incentive for the Today Tourist team to make the greatest effort to care for every detail of the journey.
Each trip was an opportunity for us to be served, to listen and to be more complete every day.
Hopefully, the past 4N3 Dao was not just a trip, but beautiful memories for you to remember.
May you and your family have a great deal of health, joy, and peace.
I look forward to continuing with you on your journeys ahead.
